name: Voxel Billboard Rendering
definition: A rendering technique where a 3D volume (CloudVolume) is represented by a set of billboards (quads) positioned at voxel locations. Each billboard is rendered as an instanced quad, with per-instance attributes defining its position and scale within the volume grid.
summary: Voxel Billboard Rendering represents 3D scalar fields as instanced 2D quads, using CPU-side sorting and generation to efficiently render volumetric data via standard rasterization pipelines.
